standbyActorName.title: Standby Actor name
standbyActorName.description: Name (not id) of the standby Actor to call, owned by the acting user -- e.g. "standby-actor". The Actor id is built at run time as "{username}~{name}" from the acting user's own username (resolved via client.user('me').get()), so the same input works unchanged on the real platform and locally.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: Greeting text sent to the standby Actor's /echo endpoint.
